text:
Maya: Quick callout  Launch in 6 days. New idea: instead of fully pausing the weekly, run a 'split-toggle' — send a short, focused launch sequence to top quantile (Q1 engagement) and a condensed weekly with a launch highlight to the rest. Thoughts?
Luca: interesting. keeps broad reach but preserves CTR for core audience. how do we define Q1?
Priya: propose engagement quantiles by recent opens+clicks: Q1 = top 20% active (30d), Q2 = next 30% (30-90d), Q3 = remainder. Q1 gets 3-launch emails; Q2 gets announcement + tutorial; Q3 gets evergreen weekly with a small launch banner.
Sam: we should also run a micro reactivation flow for the bottom 15%: 2 re-engage emails and a frequency toggle in user prefs. If still inactive -> move to long-term suppression after 120d.
Maya: good. exclusions: paying customers, trials <365d, webinar RSVPs, partners, and snooze_opt_out.
ops: can run export. need exact SQL and sample sizes to estimate send capacity.
Priya: SQL snippet for Q1 (sample):
```sql
SELECT email
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE status='subscribed'
  AND (opens_30d + clicks_30d) >= (SELECT percentile_cont(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (opens_30d + clicks_30d)) FROM newsletter_subscribers)
  AND snooze_opt_out = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE customers.email = newsletter_subscribers.email AND customers.trial_started_at > now() - interval '365 days');
```
Luca: A/B tests: Subject A = "Launch: low-latency benchmarks + quickstart" vs B = "What Redwood shipping this week". Also test banner vs inline module for Q3.
Sam: send-time split 10am vs 3pm local for Q1; single global send 11am PT for Q2/Q3. Track opens, CTR, unsubscribe rate.
Maya: KPI ask for execs: show projected open-rate uplift if we preserve Q1 engagement and mute low-engagers (estimate +2.5pp net). I'll draft a slide.
ops: actionable next steps:
- Priya: finalize quantiles and copy by tomorrow 10:00.
- Ops: run exports for Q1/Q2/Q3 and micro-reactivate cohort, deliver CSV by EOD tomorrow.
- Sam: set up A/B tests and banner/module flags in ESP.
marketing-bot: Campaign setup: "split_toggle_launch_apr2026" id cm_2026_split_toggle_01  assets pending.
Maya: sounds good. if no objections by EOD we'll proceed with split-toggle + micro-reactivate + 120d suppression.
Luca: no objections.
Priya: dropping subject lines and banner mock in the doc now.
Sam: will wire tests once CSV is in.
